text:
Anya: quick thought 1: what if we add a 'soft-cut' degrade mode in the rollout console to smooth user-visible failures during rollouts?
Mike: how's that different from current fallback? sounds like partial degradation not full model swap.
Anya: exactly. soft-cut = keep request routing stable but switch to a quantized/low-cost variant + enforce max tokens and a 'truncated' marker.
Elaine: audit caveat: we must emit deterministic decision events so an operator can replay why soft-cut fired. retention?
Anya: default 30d for these decision breadcrumbs, with opt-in extension per-customer. events include reason tags and a sampling id.
Sam: API compatibility: where does the client see this? header, body field? avoid breaking changes.
Anya: plan: top-level nullable field `redwood.degrade_info` (SDKs map later). safe for older clients if absent.
Mike: console telemetry: show p95, degrade-rate, degrade-reasons breakdown, and a heatmap by route+model.
Elaine: operator peek: need scrubbed samples with an operator consent flow to inspect degraded outputs (PII-safe).
Sam: rollout config idea: support `normal|soft-cut|hard-fallback` as actions and thresholds can be multi-signal.
Mike: multi-signal thresholds = 5xx surge, tail latency, token burn. combine with weights or AND/OR rules.
Anya: UX pill near rollout selector toggles soft-cut, shows sampling rate and recent triggers. click opens inspector with traces.
Elaine: export: CSV of triggers with columns (ts, route, reason, sample_id, operator_override). legal asked for this.
Sam: ops override: operator can pause soft-cut for route N minutes with comment; action is auditable and creates rollback probe.
ops-bot: notice 1: policy `soft-cut` created in sandbox. Use `/ops list-policies` to view.
Mike: streaming edge-case: don't change model mid-stream. evaluate only at request start, mark subsequent requests if tail latency degrades.
Anya: simulation mode in console to replay historical traces through soft-cut settings and estimate user-visible regressions + cost delta.
Elaine: simulation must scrub outputs; legal will need a summary report per-customer.
Sam: runtime hook: expose small proto decision API `{route, model_version, latency, error_class, quota_state}` -> action `{allow|soft_cut|fallback}` + metadata.
Mike: ensure protos are tiny and versioned. add hysteresis to avoid oscillation.
Anya: progressive experiments: target `X% soft-cut` then roll to `X% normal`. useful for gradual exposure.
Elaine: operator UX: show causal chain "why" in plain language and a single-click unwind (pause/escalate).
Sam: test plan: unit tests for decision hook, e2e sim with historical traces, SDK mapping tests, internal canary.
Anya: next steps: I'll mock pill + inspector screens in Figma, Mike to draft proto, Elaine to write export schema, Sam to prepare SDK compatibility PR.
Mike: starting proto sketch today.
Elaine: drafting schema and will loop in legal.
Sam: will queue SDK PR after proto stable.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: ux/softcut-proto -> staging at 2026-03-21T15:04Z.
Anya: thanks team 1: will post Figma link shortly. :thumbsup:
